purpose: Fail-closed Phase 12 production-freeze eligibility. Verifies exact evidence identities only; never mutates approval flags, allowlists, branches, assets or release state.
identity_rules: Candidate SHA-256 must match promotion packet, promotion receipt, every Phase 4-11 exit packet, owner records and both final assets.
Bare and dressed assets must be distinct repository-local files with exact SHA-256 and the same candidate lineage.
Phase 10 and 11 exit packets must target the exact final standalone runtime commit.
The promotion eligibility receipt must bind the exact promotion-packet SHA-256 that it verified.
The final freeze authorization must bind the exact candidate, final assets, runtime commit, promotion packet and promotion receipt.
Any byte, candidate, runtime commit or referenced report change invalidates the freeze packet until reverified.
non_mutation_rules: This verifier never edits the standalone runtime branch or production allowlist.
This verifier never moves/replaces the R2 deformation baseline.
This verifier never creates owner acceptance or authorization from inference.
A successful receipt means prerequisites are satisfied for a separate controlled owner-authorised release operation.
